**Unofficial build.** This is re:Blue with an in-game Cheats page added. It is not made or supported by the re:Blue team: please report problems with it here, not to them.

You still need your own copy of Blue Dragon; see the README for installing it. Some cheats change your save for good; the README's Cheats section marks those with a **Risk** note. Back up your save first.

**Credits:** the re:Blue team and contributors for re:Blue itself; [oshata](https://github.com/oshata/reblue-cheats) for the original Cheats page; HimoShifu for the Blue Dragon Cheat Engine table. Licensed BSD 3-Clause, see LICENSE.

**Downloads:** `-win-amd64` is Windows (64-bit), `-x86_64.AppImage` is Linux on PCs, `-aarch64.AppImage` is Linux on ARM.
